note: REFUGIO's model catalog. Settings > Models > 'Check for better models' fetches this file from the branch you installed, so a newly-rated model reaches people WITHOUT them updating REFUGIO. scripts/mem-fit.cjs stays the installer's source of truth and the fallback when this file cannot be reached; entries here add to that ladder and override its figures by tag.

fields.tag: Ollama model name, with an explicit size tag. Required.
fields.ramGb: Approximate resident RAM under Ollama at Q4 with a modest KV cache. Required.
fields.tools: Can it drive REFUGIO's connectors at all? Required, boolean. This is the gate the whole product hangs on.
fields.nativeTools: Can it drive Open WebUI's native function calling, as opposed to OWUI's prompt-based mode?
fields.rank: Hand-assigned capability score, higher is better. Independent of ramGb — that is the point: a newer small model can outrank an older large one. Built-in ladder entries are 10, 20, 30... so a catalog entry can land between them.
fields.verified: Has someone actually watched this model call a REFUGIO connector? Unverified models are listed and downloadable, and are NEVER recommended.
fields.note: One line shown next to the model in Settings.
fields.added: When this entry was added to the catalog.
